answer: Illegal pumps were skimming an unmetered karst spring. A claim pays after a ranger seeds a 2.4-kg walnut shell dye packet at river kilometre 17, logs a 14-minute travel time through the 480 m conduit, and photographs a 9-cm staff gauge at the resurgence, locking 18 POA for 5 epochs. Three desks recompute the breakthrough curve in 0.8 s and must match a 3 percent concentration peak plus a 0.4 m head drop. One key may seed 1 packet per epoch, so 28 aliases lock 504 POA. A reused packet batch-code, or two curves sharing 11 of 12 inflection times, burns 10 POA and bars that key for 4 epochs.
